title: An extension of Birkhoff's representation theorem to locally-finite distributive lattices
summary: Birkhoff's representation theorem identifies a finite distributive lattice with the lattice of order ideals of its poset of join-irreducible elements This can be extended to identifying a finitary distributive lattice with the lattice of finite order ideals of its poset of join-irreducible elements. Each of these representations can be extended into a duality, where the representation and reconstruction are inverse constructions between the isomorphism classes of the selected class of distributive lattices and the isomorphism classes of of the selected class of posets.
